thread:
pagerduty: :rotating_light: INC-2026-314: API Gateway error rate spike detected (502/504) — >20% of requests failing across eu-west-1 and us-east-1. Auto-pager triggered.

maria: I’m on call. Seeing alerts: latency + 5xx surge on gateway. Triage channel open.

lee: pulling logs, looks like backend upstream timeouts spiking for the auth and inference routes.

raj: Gateway team — confirming increased 502s from edge -> apigw cluster. Might be rate-limited upstream or SNI issue.

jess: CS flagged 3 enterprise customers reporting errors for import flows. Notified account leads.

maria: First steps: 1) confirm scope (regions/routes) 2) engage backends 3) if needed, fail traffic to fallback region or enable safefallback policies.

lee: scope: auth/* and v1/inference/generate are the big ones. Error distribution: 65% eu-west-1, 30% us-east-1, 5% other.

raj: Can we get a sampling of raw gateway responses?

lee: paste sample:
```
502 Bad Gateway
{"error":"upstream timeout","upstream_host":"10.2.3.45:443","request_id":"req_01F..."}
```

maria: Ok looks upstream timeouts. Raj, can gateway circuit breakers be tuned to fail fast and reduce cascade?

raj: We can flip the short-circuit flag for the failing upstream pool to 250ms and activate per-route retry=0 to avoid retries amplifying load. Rolling that now.

ops-bot: @maria executed: `gatewayctl set-cb --pool auth-pool --timeout 250ms --retries 0` — job id 83421 — success.

lee: Confirming traffic rate to auth backend dropped ~42% after cb flip, error rate plateaued but still elevated.

maria: Next: trigger partial traffic reroute for inference to secondary pool and spin up additional inference replicas. Raj, can you route 30% of v1/inference to inference-readonly and spin replicas?

raj: Doing canary redirect: `gatewayctl split-traffic --route /v1/inference --weights primary:70,secondary:30` and kscale inference-deployment +4.

ops-bot: Canary redirect applied, deployment scale request submitted.

lee: Running quick health check against secondary: 200 OK on /health, 50ms p95.

jess: Notifying impacted customers: messages queued to accounts with affected requests. Will follow up with status in 15m.

maria: Monitoring dashboards — token errors for v1/inference dropped from 22% -> 9% in 5m after reroute + cb. Auth route still ~12%.

lee: Looking into recent deploys — there was a config push to auth upstream 18m ago. Rolling it back as a precaution.

ops-bot: Rollback started: deploy id dep-778 -> rolling back to dep-775. ETA ~3m.

raj: Also observed connection ECONNRESET spikes from a subset of backend hosts. Might be a transient network fabric issue. Alerting infra-net for fabric check.

maria: Good. If rollback + cb doesn't bring auth <5% we should open fallback to legacy-auth cluster. Do we have capacity?

lee: Legacy cluster has spare capacity for low-volume bursts. We can redirect 20% as fallback.

jess: Customer update: initial message sent explaining degraded experience, ETA for mitigation 20–30m.

ops-bot: Rollback completed successfully.

lee: Post-rollback metrics: auth errors decreased to 6% within 2m. Overall platform error rate now 3.5% (within SLO).

maria: Great work. Actions for now: 1) keep cb at 250ms for auth for 1h 2) leave inference split 70/30 until autoscaling stabilizes 3) infra-net to investigate fabric resets 4) support to follow up customers.

raj: I’ll own follow-up on gateway config and prepare a small playbook to revert cb and traffic split.

lee: I’ll collect logs and traces for postmortem and link evals to any regression alerts.

jess: I’ll compile the customer impact summary and send to TAMs + ops.

maria: Pagerduty: close alert when metrics hold for 30m. Setting incident status to "mitigated" but active.

pagerduty: Incident INC-2026-314 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring.

maria: Postmortem owner: raj. Draft due EOD tomorrow. If anyone has additional context (recent infra deploys, network changes), drop it here.

lee: Noted — adding logs and a few flamegraphs to the incident ticket.

raj: Will follow up with proposed config guardrails to prevent similar CB mis-tuning in the future.

jess: Support will send final customer summary once we hit steady-state.

maria: Thanks team. Stand down unless we see a re-escalation. :thumbsup:
